title: Arabic NER record (canonical input of arabic-ner-validator)
description: One record per line (JSON Lines) or an array of records. offset_unit is required and is never guessed. Offsets are [start, end) in that unit, counted on 'text' exactly as stored.

id.description: Record id; the report uses the line number when it is missing.

offset_unit.description: utf8_byte: bytes of the UTF-8 encoding; codepoint: Unicode code points (Python str); utf16: UTF-16 code units (JavaScript String); grapheme: extended grapheme clusters (UAX #29).

normalization_declared.description: The normalisation form the text is in. NFC, NFKC, NFD and NFKD are checked; policy:<id> names a project policy and is recorded only.

nested_policy.description: forbid: a span may not lie inside another span or share its extent. Crossing spans are always an error.

clitic_policy.description: include: proclitics attached to a name (و ف ب ك ل and the article) are inside the span; exclude: conjunctions and prepositions are outside and the article stays with the name; unspecified: not checked.

text.description: The span text as the annotation tool saw it; compared with text[start:end].

tokens.description: Either token strings that occur in 'text' in order, separated by whitespace, or token objects with start and end in offset_unit. When tokens are given, span edges must fall on token edges.
